title: Optimal normal approximation for symmetric statistics
summary: Rates of convergence in normal approximation are fundamental to probability and statistics. The theory has evolved from normalized sums to Studentized statistics, smooth functions of sample means, and $U$-statistics, and more generally to symmetric statistics. A central question throughout this development has been to identify the weakest assumptions under which optimal rates of convergence can be established.
